verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only the server direction: an official Anytype MCP Server and an agents skill that let external AI tools such as Claude Code or Cursor read and modify Anytype data. Nothing shows Anytype itself acting as an MCP client that connects to third-party MCP servers and uses their tools. Server-side and API capabilities belong to a different story and earn no credit here. Since a knowledge app with AI features could plausibly offer MCP client support, the axis applies, so absence of evidence is 'none' rather than 'na'.
